channel.description: Recent content in Sre on Trinidad Marroquin

item.title: Managing vSphere VM Lifecycle State With Terraform And NetBox
item.description: A lifecycle runbook for managing vSphere VM CPU, memory, disk sizing, NetBox metadata, idempotency, and teardown hygiene after initial Terraform provisioning.

item.title: Building Guardrails Around Terraform vSphere VM Lifecycle
item.description: A practical walkthrough of using Terraform validation, NetBox ownership, vCenter checks, DNS checks, network liveness tests, and teardown verification around the vSphere VM lifecycle.

item.title: AI Agent Guardrails For Infrastructure Writes
item.description: Field note for using AI agents safely during infrastructure updates, especially when the agent has tool access but may speculate or lose context.

item.title: When AI-Assisted Infrastructure Updates Need Guardrails
item.description: A practical reflection on using AI assistance for NetBox inventory work, where tool access helped but evidence, validation, and import discipline mattered more than confident answers.

item.title: When Network Saturation Looks Like Rancher Trouble
item.description: An incident-style walkthrough of a Rancher traffic anomaly where control-plane symptoms pointed at remotedialer instability, but the likely trigger was backup-window network saturation.

item.title: Actionable Alerts And Dashboards
item.description: Initial guidance for actionable alerts, useful dashboards, ownership, and SRE-style signal quality.

item.title: From Local IaC Labs To Production-Ready Patterns
item.description: A practical SRE view of how local Terraform, Docker, Helm, Kafka, and observability labs can become production-ready infrastructure patterns without pretending the lab is production.

item.title: Local SLI Labs With Prometheus Grafana And cAdvisor
item.description: Field note for using a local Docker and Terraform lab to validate service-level indicators with Prometheus, Grafana, and cAdvisor.

item.title: Multi-Site RKE2 Operations: Lessons From The Fleet
item.description: Operational lessons from running RKE2 clusters across multiple data centers: inventory design, node naming conventions, upgrade sequencing across sites, and the patterns that break first at scale.

item.title: Observability Before AI: What Every Operator Needs First
item.description: Field note for building observability foundations before introducing AI-assisted operations: structured metrics, actionable dashboards, coherent alert routing, and incident response patterns that make AI useful rather than noisy.

item.title: Operating In A GitOps Environment: Practices That Hold Up
item.description: Opinionated practices for infrastructure teams working in a GitOps model: commit messages, semver for infrastructure, CI-triggered CD tradeoffs, and deployment automation patterns that survive production use.

item.title: Post-Incident Follow-Up
item.description: Initial post-incident follow-up model for timelines, contributing factors, corrective actions, and measurable system improvements.

item.title: Removing DNS Search Domain Drift Across Multi-Site RKE2 Clusters
item.description: A production walkthrough of auditing, diagnosing, and remediating DNS search domain drift across five RKE2 cluster sites, including netplan staging, systemd-resolved link-level debugging, and a Subiquity YAML indentation trap.

item.title: SRE Mindset: Operational Judgment Over Tooling
item.description: Field note for the SRE mindset: how operators think about reliability, error budgets, incident response, toil management, and the decisions that determine whether tooling improves or complicates operations.

item.title: The SRE Dirty Dozen: Common Anti-Patterns In Site Reliability Engineering
item.description: Twelve common anti-patterns in SRE practice: alert fatigue disguised as paging, dashboards without decisions, SLI collection without SLO targets, incident reviews without action items, and other traps that SRE teams fall into.

item.title: Troubleshooting Kubernetes Storage Migration To vSphere CSI
item.description: A practical incident walkthrough for Kubernetes monitoring PVC failures, stale CSI storage, vSphere CSI attach and mount validation, and the disk.EnableUUID requirement.

item.title: Refactoring A vSphere Terraform Repo Into Environment Roots And Shared Modules
item.description: A Terraform infrastructure project writeup about reorganizing a vSphere repo into environment roots, shared modules, templates, and archived legacy state.

item.title: Using LLMs During Infrastructure Troubleshooting Without Turning Off Your Brain
item.description: Practical lessons for using LLMs during infrastructure troubleshooting while preserving operator judgment, validation, and evidence-based debugging.

item.title: Transforming Blame Culture: The DevOps Silent Productivity Killer Anti-Pattern
item.description: Part 4 of the DevOps Dirty Dozen series: how blame culture erodes trust, stalls innovation, and what it takes to build psychological safety instead.

item.title: Closing Pandora's Box: The DevOps Automating Chaos Anti-Pattern
item.description: Part 3 of the DevOps Dirty Dozen series: how automating flawed processes amplifies dysfunction — and why process clarity must come before automation.

item.title: Drowning in Choices: The DevOps Tool Overload Anti-Pattern
item.description: Part 2 of the DevOps Dirty Dozen series: how tool overload creates cognitive load, integration debt, and analysis paralysis — and what teams can do about it.

item.title: Breaking Barriers: The DevOps Silos Anti-Pattern
item.description: Part 1 of the DevOps Dirty Dozen series: how organizational silos undermine DevOps collaboration and what teams can do about it.
